test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 05 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Being courteous _______ costs you nothing.
solution:
The correct answer is **"No article required"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **"Courteous" **is an adjective describing a behaviour or trait.
 
• **"Costs you nothing"** is a phrase indicating that there is no financial or tangible expense associated with exhibiting courtesy.
 
• We do not use any article before <s
